job.title: Legal Secretary
job.description:
Looking for a Legal Secretary role that’s a little more interesting than managing diaries and chasing documents? This could be the one.

You'll need to be organised, commercially minded and confident juggling multiple priorities. Someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving problems and finding better ways of doing things will thrive here.

What you’ll be doing:
  • Billing, WIP and matter financials
  • Cost estimates and client reporting
  • Opening, closing and archiving matters
  • Managing client requirements throughout the matter lifecycle
  • Practice management and operational processes
  • Supporting pitches, presentations and slide decks
  • Coordinating firm and client events
  • Getting involved in process improvement, new technology and AI initiatives
Why you’ll love it:
  • Strong salary for the experience required - $90K-$95K package
  • 2 days WFH - flexibility without losing the team environment
  • A genuinely career-focused role, rather than a traditional Legal Secretary position
  • Work closely with senior lawyers and PA's
  • Exposure to the commercial and operational side of a major law firm
  • Excellent learning and development framework
  • Strong opportunities for career progression
  • International exposure through the firm's global relationships
  • Great employee benefits and a genuine focus on wellbeing
If you're ready for a role that gives you more than just another desk, diary and inbox, I'd love to hear from you.

Please note: You’ll need full Australian work rights for this opportunity - Australian Citizenship or Permanent Residency. Unfortunately, we’re unable to consider current law students for these roles.

Whether you're actively looking or simply curious about what else is out there, get in touch for a confidential chat.

Not every great role gets advertised for long, so if you're thinking about making a move, now is a good time to talk.

job.title: Legal Secretary - Employment - International Firm
job.description:
The Opportunity:
Join an internationally renowned law firm and work alongside a high-performing team of employment lawyers. You’ll collaborate with another legal secretary to support the team. The firm has a great down-to-earth culture, dress for your day policy and is friendly and welcoming. This role offers 1 day of work from home.

The Role:
Working in a team of 2, you will support 1 partner directly and a team of 5 lawyers; the other secretary will support the rest of the team. This is a traditional legal secretary role, and you will be assisting with:
  • Diary & email management
  • Billing
  • Assist with events and other BD activities
  • Prepare correspondence and documents
About You:
You have prior law firm experience, and we welcome applications from both intermediate-level and more senior candidates. Experience in a litigated or advisory practice area is essential, given the nature of the work. Beyond that, we are looking for a can-do attitude and the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.

What You Will Get:
A salary package of up to $105k, a central CBD office close to transport links, WFH flex and a supportive team that genuinely works as one. You’ll also enjoy all the usual big law firm perks and benefits, plus the opportunity to add an impressive name to your CV to help grow your career.
